newsitem.title: CHINA: Volkswagen to export cars from China.
newsitem.headline: Volkswagen to export cars from China.

text.p: The Shanghai Volkswagen Auto Co, a joint venture between Germany's Volkswagen and Shanghai Automotive Corp, has signed its first deal to export its Santana sedan cars, the Xinhua news agency said.

The first group of 51 Santana 2000 cars will be exported at the end of this month under an agreement signed at the ongoing Guangzhou Export Commodity Fair, Xinhua said. It did not give the destination of the exports.
These will be the first cars the joint venture has exported.
Shanghai Volkswagen has exported auto accessories and engines worth about $20 million a year.
